title: Blind Motor Sunset Automation Miss
app: Aqara, IKEA Tradfri, LIFX, Nanoleaf, Shelly, Zigbee2MQTT, Ecobee, and smart blind motors via vendor clouds, LAN APIs, MQTT bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=blindmotor:state
| where automation_name="sunset_close"
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count(eval(result="missed")) as missed_closes by blind _time
| where missed_closes>0
| sort - missed_closes
description: Uses Blind sunset-close events telemetry to monitor whether sunset automations actually finished as planned in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for missed shade closes that leave rooms exposed or hot, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Blind sunset-close events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily table of missed sunset-close automations.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges whether sunset automations actually finished as planned so you can spot missed shade closes that leave rooms exposed or hot before it becomes annoying.
